scope: Independent local evidence review of two existing live acceptance reports; no additional live calls or changes to original runs.
overall_result: All four bounded acceptance scenarios passed after a harness-only generated-image retry. The initial harness failure is retained below.

sanitization.billing_estimates_omitted: Product cost telemetry was not independently verified against provider billing. Token receipts are summarized instead.

retry_child_transcript.location: Retry run isolated subagent transcript selected through the parent task result and completed subagent metadata.

routing_and_limits.transport: Authenticated loopback relay to the pinned upstream endpoint; relay counts outgoing HTTP requests including retries.
routing_and_limits.capability_selection: Isolated manual capability overrides and an explicit vision-role model; not a capability probe or official fallback-selection test.
routing_and_limits.image_policy: Only exact synthetic PNG fixture bytes may be sent, and only to the selected Vision model.
routing_and_limits.host_policy: The retry exposes one schema-enumerated command selecting an immutable harness-owned PowerShell script executed by the real native host_command tool.
routing_and_limits.permission_scope: Isolated explicit host-operation, read, task and selected-provider image-send permissions; no product permission relaxation or automation-fullaccess change.
routing_and_limits.other_tools: Other assembled capabilities are explicitly denied; the relay presents only task and the bounded host command.
routing_and_limits.credential_handling: Stdin-only credential input; real credential retained in relay memory rather than tool context or configuration.

timing_definition: First delta is the first parent-visible text delta, not an HTTP header, reasoning delta, or the child model's first token. Commit is the parent final-answer commit. Null commit values mean no commit occurred.

scenarios.name: main-generated-task-vision
scenarios.failure_summary: The original exact long-command wrapper rejected the supplied command before native execution; final readiness rejected the latest failed host action. No generated frame or Vision delegation occurred.
scenarios.diagnostic_limit: The original run did not retain raw tool arguments or a session transcript, so the precise argument mismatch cannot be determined from its evidence.

false_pass_review.scope: Current harness verifier and recorded local reports, parent/child transcripts, metadata, artifact hashes, and budget ledger; not an independent provider wire capture or visual-capability benchmark.

findings.finding: Answer verification uses substring presence, not exact structured field validation. Negated or contradictory answers can satisfy it; a fixed repeated fixture also cannot rule out guessing.
findings.this_run_assessment: The actual child answer and final parent answer independently match the expected synthetic fields without contradiction. The expected identifier was absent from pre-result parent text and child input text. This supports this bounded result, not general visual accuracy.

findings.finding: The verifier checks tool dispatch names, an image-bearing HTTP 200 and at least one usage receipt, rather than requiring successful ordered tool results, matched parent-child linkage, or complete per-call usage coverage. Generated file-byte equality is separately checked, but Verified alone is still insufficient evidence of the whole causal chain.
findings.this_run_assessment: Independent review confirmed a successful native host result before the task, completed linked child metadata, the matching image snapshot in the child transcript, the child answer returned through task, a committed final answer, and four unique usage receipts for the four retry calls.

coverage_limits: Manual capability overrides and an explicit Vision role do not test automatic capability probing or official fallback selection.
The generated image comes from a deterministic harness-owned script invoked by the main model, not unrestricted model-authored image-generation code.
Live execution uses isolated explicit allows; ask/deny/auto boundary behavior is covered by separate hermetic tests, not these live reports.
An image-bearing request and correct static-fixture answer establish bounded integration evidence, not proof that a model attended to pixels or broad image-reasoning correctness.
